decisions.decision: Vector socket path: /run/vector/syslog.sock (not /dev/log)
decisions.rationale: Vector user can't create socket in /dev (root-owned). /run/ is tmpfs, writable by all. Symlink /dev/log → /run/vector/syslog.sock for compatibility.

decisions.decision: vector-setup service in boot stage (not sysinit)
decisions.rationale: /var/log is btrfs subvolume mounted by localmount in boot stage. vector-setup needs /var/log for chown.

decisions.decision: vector-setup: chown /var/log without -R flag
decisions.rationale: Files created by Vector are already owned by vector user. Only directory ownership needed. Much faster than recursive chown.

decisions.decision: Vector config written AFTER package install
decisions.rationale: apk add vector overwrites /etc/vector/vector.yaml with demo_logs placeholder. Config must be written after install.

decisions.decision: Vector check: apk info | grep -q '^vector$'
decisions.rationale: Init-system agnostic, works with OpenRC and future dinit. Better than checking /etc/init.d/vector.

decisions.decision: internalRules.yaml: only base OS in defaultRunlevels
decisions.rationale: Services moved to packageLogic. defaultRunlevels only contains kernel/OS services.

decisions.decision: udev services in packageLogic under eudev
decisions.rationale: Alpine uses mdev by default. udev services only needed when eudev is installed.

decisions.decision: modules service removed from boot runlevel
decisions.rationale: booster loads /etc/modules automatically. modules service not needed with booster.

decisions.decision: btrbk snapshot_dir: /btrbk/snapshots (not /mnt/btrbk/snapshots)
decisions.rationale: Correct path for btrfs subvolume mount point.

decisions.decision: Vector VRL syntax: parse_syslog() ?? {} fallback
decisions.rationale: parse_syslog() is fallible, needs error handling. Added ?? {} fallback for unparseable messages.

decisions.decision: rsyslog/logrotate replaced with vector (Rust)
decisions.rationale: Memory-safe logging pipeline. Vector 0.55.0 in Alpine edge/community.

decisions.decision: Package masking removed from installer
decisions.rationale: Alpine apk masking via /etc/apk/world conflicts with explicit package dependencies.

decisions.decision: zram-init removed, replaced with zswap + swap file
decisions.rationale: zswap is kernel feature for compressed swap cache. More flexible than zram.

decisions.decision: Test artifacts: tests/artifacts/<tool-name>/<timestamp>/
decisions.rationale: All test outputs go to tests/artifacts/<tool-name>/<timestamp>/.

decisions.decision: Harness writes variables.yaml directly instead of stdin
decisions.rationale: Replaced writeHarnessSetupInput + writeHarnessRuntimeOverrides with writeHarnessVariables.

decisions.decision: Clevis TPM2 bind policy: {} (no PCR policy, TPM identity only)
decisions.rationale: PCR7 mismatch between bind time and boot time in QEMU/OVMF caused sealed keys to fail.

decisions.decision: LUKS keyfile embedded in initramfs for auto-unlock
decisions.rationale: booster waits for interactive passphrase in QEMU headless — keyfile in initramfs enables automatic unlock.

decisions.decision: booster instead of mkinitfs for initramfs
decisions.rationale: booster is faster, simpler, and supports LUKS2 natively

decisions.decision: Signed UKI instead of GRUB
decisions.rationale: Unified Kernel Image enables Secure Boot without GRUB complexity

decisions.decision: Btrfs RAID1 on LUKS (not mdadm)
decisions.rationale: Btrfs native RAID1 is simpler and more reliable than mdadm

LUKS keyfile auto-unlock, console=ttyS0,115200, per-device keyfile args

risks.details: Alpine default config is demo_logs (fake syslog to console). Our custom config uses socket /dev/log which crashes. supervise-daemon respawns 5x then gives up. vector.log is empty.
